※ 預防帳號遭盜用，請定期修改密碼！

為配合教育部資安稽核計畫及行政院國家資通安全會報之政府組態基準(GCB)要求，請本校教職員工及學生自公告日(2020/10/14)起依循下列規範：

  • 密碼不得少於8碼密碼，不得與上次密碼相同密碼，至少必須包含英文大寫字母、小寫字母、數字、特殊符號
  • 密碼不能包含與使用者帳戶名稱三個或以上的相同字元
  • 密碼不能與前三次相同
  • 密碼有效期間為180天，180天後需再修改密碼才可使用校內各系統(系統會自動要求修改密碼)
  • 密碼錯誤10次，帳號會被鎖15分鐘，15分鐘後自動解鎖

自2020/11/2起，使用各資訊系統時，將檢核您是否已於公告日後修改密碼並符合上述規範，未修改及不符合者，均須先修改密碼才能繼續使用各系統。

※To protect your account , change your password periodically.

In order to comply with the information security audit plan and the Government Configuration Benchmark (GCB) requirements, please change your password according to the following regulations:

  1. The new password must contains at least eight characters long and it's significantly different from previous passwords. The password also needs to contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, number, and symbols.
  2. Password cannot contain three or more characters that match user account name.
  3. The password cannot be the same as the previous three times.
  4. The password is valid for 180 days, so you need to change the password again after 180 days.
  5. If the password is fault more over 10 times, the account will be lock 15 mins.

Please change your password as soon as possible. From November 2nd, 2020, information systems would check whether your password has been changed and then verify to access the system. We apologize for any inconvenience.
